description: Two silent-unless-relevant hook sets. The dashboard-kit notice: one line at session start in a repository whose Fabric dashboard has no kit or an older one (fabric-dashboard/0.1, DEC-0036). The Fabric session hooks (working-with-fabric, COM-04, FAA-12a): at session start the preamble when Claude Code has the MCP server `fabric` (fabric_whoami, then the project board through com.status and com.list, claim and release), and the machine's Fabric-service count; each turn's facts (HEAD, files changed, lines added and removed, never content), the board's unread count and the session's end through Fabric, only when the running Fabric advertises session-hooks/1; at each prompt one line only when the unread count rose. All silent in a session Fabric launched. Every hook reads no token, prints at most one block, always exits 0, and hands any Fabric call to a detached worker with a 10 s deadline.
